criterion: The catalogue prints its total beside the facet control at the head of the work route.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a number is visible beside the facet control at the top of the work route, before any film tile. Answer no when the number appears only inside the opened facet list, or is absent from the head of the route.

criterion: Each facet option in the opened filter list carries its own count beside its label.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when All, Branded and Entertainment each show a number beside the label in the opened list. Answer no when any of the three shows a label with no number.

criterion: A catalogue tile prints the label Type followed by a slash before the value.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a tile shows the label Type with a slash between the label and the value. Answer no when the label is missing, or the value follows the label with no slash.

criterion: The header prints the studio open state beside a dot filled during opening hours.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the header shows an open state as words with a dot beside it. Answer no when the header shows the words with no dot, or the dot with no words.

criterion: Opening a case study from a filtered catalogue leads onward to another film of the same type.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the link at the foot of a case study reached from the Branded filter opens another Branded film. Answer no when it opens a film of the other type, or leads back to the unfiltered catalogue.

criterion: Switching the catalogue view mode keeps that choice through a reload.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the view chosen before a reload is the view shown after it. Answer no when the reload returns the catalogue to the other view.

criterion: Every film tile reserves its media box at full size in the signal red before the media arrives.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a tile whose media has yet to load shows a solid coloured rectangle at the size the media will occupy. Answer no when the tile collapses to nothing, shows a grey placeholder, or shifts when the media lands.

criterion: A display heading on the home route is set with its lines almost touching, so the stacked headline reads as one solid mass.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the lines of a multi-line display heading sit closer together than the height of the letters. Answer no when the lines sit apart like ordinary paragraph text.

criterion: The leading dot beside the current navigation item scales up into place rather than fading in.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the dot grows from nothing to full size on becoming current. Answer no when the dot changes only in opacity, or appears at full size with no movement.

criterion: The slash separators between navigation items stay silent to a screen reader.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the navigation reads as a list of destinations with no separator announced between them. Answer no when a separator is announced between every pair.

criterion: At a phone width the catalogue grid becomes a single column with nothing overflowing sideways.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when tiles stack one per row at a phone width with no sideways scrolling. Answer no when two tiles share a row, or the page scrolls sideways.

criterion: The shop presents its digital products as a scattered pile of cards holding one arrangement across visits.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the product cards sit at varied angles and offsets, in the same arrangement on a second visit. Answer no when the cards sit in a plain aligned grid, or rearrange themselves between visits.

criterion: A facet with an empty result shows a message naming the type alongside a control returning to every film.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when an empty facet shows a sentence naming the type alongside a control that returns to all films. Answer no when the grid is blank, or an error page appears.

criterion: An unresolved count prints as an empty bracket pair.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a count that failed to resolve shows a bracket pair with nothing inside. Answer no when the same count shows a zero.

criterion: The podcast archive groups its episodes under a heading for each season, newest season first.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when each season heading is followed by the episodes of that season, with the highest season heading at the top. Answer no when the episodes run as one undivided list, or the oldest season heads the page.

criterion: A film under embargo appears among the catalogue tiles.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a tile for the embargoed film is visible in the catalogue grid. Answer no when the catalogue shows only the publicly readable films.

criterion: A page-level error screen replaces the catalogue when a facet value is unknown.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when an unknown facet value produces an error screen. Answer no when it falls back to every film with a message above the grid.

criterion: The page ground behind the catalogue grid is a near-white neutral sheet.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the area around the film tiles is an almost-white surface with no perceptible colour cast. Answer no when that area is white, mid grey, dark, or tinted.

criterion: The current navigation item carries the signal red beside a filled dot.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the navigation item for the route on screen is red with a solid dot before its label. Answer no when the current item looks like the others, or carries the colour with no dot.

criterion: The signal red is confined to the current route marker, the live dot, the active facet, the full-bleed panels, the reserved media boxes.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when every red thing on screen is one of those five. Answer no when a heading, a border, a button ground or a body of text wears the same red.

criterion: Body text on the catalogue meets the AA contrast bar against its background.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a tile's synopsis reads comfortably against the surface behind it at the AA bar. Answer no when the synopsis is a light grey on an almost-white sheet, or is otherwise hard to read at body size.

criterion: Movement on the catalogue covers most of its distance at once, settling into place afterwards.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a transition leaves quickly then eases to a stop. Answer no when it moves at one steady rate, or lands with a bounce past its resting place.

criterion: A section that has entered stays in place when the visitor scrolls back up.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when scrolling past a section then back leaves it fully visible. Answer no when the section fades or slides in a second time.
